description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Black Sun's Twilight, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Black Sun's Twilight, giving Dualcaster Mage -5/-5 until end of turn and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Dualcaster Mage dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Black Sun's Twilight, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Black Sun's Twilight, giving Naru Meha -5/-5 until end of turn and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 3.
